lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters are arranged in approximately four horizontal rows along the visible mid-lateral flank, with higher spot density observed towards the dorsal boundary.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible, intersecting with the primary horizontal rows of blobs to form a semi-regular grid-like pattern across the mid-section of the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two prominent horizontal linear features are visible running along the flank; the primary ridge displays a sharp vertical gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal-facing edge and deep shadow on the ventral-facing edge.

other_distinctive_markers: A dense concentration of small, high-luminance points is visible on the cranial surface, localized anterior to the first gill slit and dorsal to the mouth line.
